rationale.conceptual: The model involves multiple interacting components: three temperature-dependent exponent formulas, piecewise Debye integrals with three phonon scattering mechanisms (boundary, point-defect, three-phonon), and distinct phonon branches. Although all formulas are provided, correctly implementing the equations, integration limits, and unit conversions requires non-trivial care and understanding of the underlying condensed-matter physics. It is an established but non-trivial algorithm, not a simple textbook operation.
rationale.execution: The task is a single-step computation: a single Python script using numpy/scipy performs all calculations and writes a single CSV file. No multi-stage pipeline, no complex environment setup beyond a pip install, and no external data fetching.
